title: Stored-energy release during handling
statement: Given the hop actuator stores spring or flywheel energy while operators set up the demonstrator, there is a possibility of unintended release, resulting in impact injury to an operator.
mitigation: Guard interlock; hardwired e-stop (ASTER-SYS-005, ASTER-SUB-004); energy dump before approach (ASTER-SYS-006); second mechanical safety pin
trigger: Any latch proof-load failure or interlock fault

title: Flywheel rotor burst
statement: Given the flywheel option spins a rotor storing about 5.9 J, there is a possibility of rotor or hub failure, resulting in fragments leaving the demonstrator.
mitigation: Containment ring sized for full rotor energy; hardwired overspeed trip; rotor speed capped at 76.5 rad/s design value
trigger: Rotor speed above cap in any test log

title: Counterweight runaway or cable snag
statement: Given the offload rig suspends the demonstrator against a counterweight, there is a possibility of cable snag or breakage, resulting in falling masses and crush injury.
mitigation: Arrestor and safety net (ASTER-SYS-008); pre-trial cable inspection log; exclusion zone
trigger: Cable inspection finding or arrest distance above 0.3 m

title: Pinch during spring arming
statement: Given the spring leg is wound by a motor with the operator nearby, there is a possibility of hand entrapment in the leg linkage, resulting in finger injury.
mitigation: Arm only with guard closed; two-hand arming control; winding current limit

title: Over-speed hop on the target body
statement: Given launch speed is estimated from IMU data, there is a possibility of an underestimate, resulting in a hop above the 0.085 m/s limit and possible loss of vehicle.
mitigation: Software release inhibit (ASTER-SUB-001); estimator calibration before each trial; keep limit at 28 % of circular-orbit speed
trigger: Estimator error above 0.005 m/s in any calibration

title: Analogue rig not representative
statement: Given a counterweight rig cannot reproduce 1.9e-4 m/s2, there is a possibility that friction and inertia dominate the measured hops, resulting in invalid concept comparisons.
mitigation: Characterise rig residual acceleration with calibration drops (ASTER-VER-007); compare against analysis before using trial data

title: Unknown regolith restitution
statement: Given regolith restitution is unknown between 0.2 and 0.8, there is a possibility of longer bouncing than planned, resulting in settle times above 2400 s.
mitigation: Bound analysis over restitution 0.2-0.8 (BNC cases); seek published restitution data for Phase 2
trigger: Any new data showing restitution above 0.8

title: Battery thermal event in the laboratory
statement: Given the demonstrator carries a lithium battery pack, there is a possibility of a cell thermal event during charging, resulting in fire in the laboratory.
mitigation: Charge only in a fire-safe container under supervision; pack with cell-level protection
trigger: Any cell temperature above 45 C during charge
